_note: Ambient life on the inner map (ui/ambientModel.js, ui/innerMapLayers/ambient.js): fires that flicker and spit embers, smoke from chimneys, steam, lamps at night, and moving parts drawn from art in artDir when it exists. Units: tiles and seconds. Positions ('at') are in tiles from the anchor tile's top-left (an object's anchor is its bottom-left cell). Particles are effects drawn in code (soft puffs, glints); anything that is an object (a waterwheel, sails, a bucket) comes from art listed in <artDir>/manifest.json, merged in as `art` by build:data.
_windDoc: A map's wind for the day: strength from `calm` [min, max] by hash of the place and day, times the weather's factor. `lift`: how much it blows toward/away from the view rather than across.
_weatherDoc: Wet or snowy air: smoke hangs thicker (alpha) and breaks up sooner (life).
_kindsDoc: Particle kinds. color [r,g,b]; life [min,max] s; rise tiles/s at birth (riseDecay -1..1: above 0 it slows with age, below 0 it gathers speed, so the plume is thick at the mouth; gravity pulls it back down); size [start,end] tiles; alpha at its fullest; fadeIn share of life; drift how much the wind takes it; wobble/wobbleHz a sideways sway; spread tiles either side of the source; fling a sideways throw; twinkle Hz; glow true = drawn additively after the night lighting (it shines in the dark).
_schedulesDoc: How hard a kind of fire burns by the hour: hours [[hour, level]] (linear between); season multiplies by season; cold adds up to that share on cold days (below 15°C, full by -10°C); max caps it. A building or fire is lit once the level passes its own threshold (so houses light one by one), and burns harder as it rises.
_buildingsDoc: By building type (buildings.json buildingType): chimney = emitters on each chimney pot (noChimney: where on the roof they rise instead when the building has no chimney drawn, [share of width, tiles below its top]; without it, no chimney, no smoke); roof = emitters across the roof (at [share of its width, tiles below its top]); schedule from `schedules`; share = the part of such buildings that burn at all. `_default` serves any type not listed (a type set to {} gives nothing).
_objectsDoc: Map objects by def id. frames: play the sheet cells to the right (count, step in cells [dx, dy], fps) — the campfire sheet already holds 4 flame frames. emit: particles at 'at'. glow: a soft warm halo (radius tiles, day/night strength, flicker). light: a light in the night light map (radius tiles). lit: a schedule that turns the whole thing on (a lamp lit only in the dark).
_furnitureDoc: Inside a building, by furniture type (data/furniture.json types; interiorArt sprites). Same fields as objects.
_breathDoc: Breath in the cold: below `belowC` °C each person outdoors breathes out a small puff every `every` seconds (only the player and those on screen). head: the mouth's height above the tile centre (tiles); side: how far before the face, toward the way they look.
_partsDoc: Moving parts drawn from art in artDir (each an entry in its manifest.json: file, w, h, tilesW, tilesH, frames, pivot). Nothing shows until the art is there. on: buildingTypes / objects; place: 'waterSide' (on the building's wall above water, the lower part in it), 'roof' (top middle of its roof), 'object' (at the object's anchor); at: offset tiles; spin: turns a second (rotation about the pivot; 0 = none); fps: frame rate when it has frames; every: play the frames once every so many seconds (else loop); sway: degrees of rocking; spray: particle kind thrown up where it meets the water; unlessWater: only where 'waterSide' finds no water.
